# VOID — generated by a defective sampler

Everything in this directory was produced **before** the 2026-08-09 U-turn
repair (`_span_endpoints`, `src/abnuts/nuts/transition.py`).

The subtree U-turn criterion was evaluated with its endpoints in visit order
rather than trajectory order, so every backward subtree reported a U-turn on its
first step regardless of geometry. Realized tree depth was therefore a
direction coin-flip sequence, geometric with p=0.5 and identical on every
target, instead of a function of the posterior's geometry.

Consequences for these files:

- Trajectories were far shorter than intended and `max_tree_depth` was
  effectively unreachable, so all timing and work figures describe a sampler
  that is not NUTS.
- Warm timings were additionally single-shot, before the min-of-N repeat fix,
  and carry roughly 5-15% noise.

**Do not quote, plot, or cite any number in this directory.** Valid post-repair
artifacts live in the directories listed in `STATUS.md` under the current active
task.

Stamped 2026-08-09.
